name: PolyAPI w Go
postCreateCommand: bash -c '[ ! -f go.mod ] && go mod init sfdc-go || true; go mod tidy'
postStartCommand: echo "${GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN}" | gh auth login --with-token && echo 'Authentication successful' && git config --global --add safe.directory "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && bash -c 'go build -o main . && ./main'
